$comment: Read by deploy/cron/scheduler.mjs. Times are UTC. everyMinutes runs on minute boundaries divisible by it; dailyAt runs once a day at HH:MM. Mirrors apps/web/vercel.json except watch-deposits (a no-op stub while deposits are disabled; set everyMinutes to 1 when crediting goes live). chain-events sends queued game results to Solana (README On-chain). replays-retention deletes admin replays older than 14 days. invariants runs the read-only nightly invariant check (B6) and alerts on a mismatch.
